reviews.reviewText:
Paper bohat acha hua. MCQs totally Mam Almas ki Objective File se thay aur subjective highlighted handouts se.
Questions:
- Difference between Software Requirements & other requirements
- List the name of attributes of Software Requirements
- What is functional requirements
- Difference between pre-release and post-release defects
- Name the tool used for log and track defects
- Three categories of defects

Mujhy yeh yad nai k kon sa long ha or kon sa short but jo jin topics sy paper ayah tha wo yeh hen(SPI k formula k ilawa har Questions men scenarios diya huy thy)
1. Structural testing.
2. Functional requirement.
3. Testing tool
4. SPI ka formula
5. Functional testing ( long or short dono ay thy is men sy)
6. Regression testing.
7. Domain knowledge 
8. Most Important topic👇🏼
Attribute of software Requirement (is men sy long short dono ay thy)
9. Activities in software testing
